Assumption Control PostureLink

Control lensCurrent postureFounder readRequired response
Validation disciplineAll five critical assumptions have owners and dated validation windows.The system knows what must be proved, but proof quality is still uneven.Keep every assumption tied to a source route, fallback path, and next validation action.
Dependency concentrationCash timing, garlic sourcing, and live-gate behavior remain tightly coupled.One weak proof point can distort several executive decisions at once.Treat linked dependency movement as portfolio risk, not isolated friction.
Founder-rescue exposureLive-gate behavior is still the main hidden assumption.Founder presence cannot be counted as an operating control.Require owner-led executable-check proof before trust-linked movement widens.
Capital sensitivitySeveral assumptions influence cash, release, or concession posture.Soft belief can quietly become capital allocation if the board does not stop it.Route assumption drift to capital allocation before new commitments expand.
Forecast qualityForecast confidence depends on validation timing, not only commercial enthusiasm.Weighted upside should not outrun evidence-backed capacity or payment posture.Downgrade confidence bands when validation dates slip or fallback quality weakens.

Validation Gate RulesLink

GateConditionEvidence requiredDashboard actionFounder action
ProveAssumption is materially influencing forecast, capital, release, or customer promise.Current source record, owner, validation date, and fallback path.Keep in active validation register.Require dated proof before widening commitment.
DowngradeAssumption misses validation date, source proof weakens, or owner evidence becomes stale.Updated forecast, risk, variance, and source-board language.Reduce confidence band and flag dependency heat.Narrow commitment or pause related release.
Convert to varianceAssumption failure creates repeated drift or founder-rescued execution.Plan variance record and owner accountability evidence.Move from assumption watch to recovery review.Set recovery owner and deadline.
Escalate to scenarioFailure would affect cash, supply, trust-linked release, or key counterparty timing.Scenario response path and first-response owner.Route to contingency board.Approve fallback posture or containment.
GraduateAssumption holds through validation, source evidence is current, and fallback is no longer primary.KPI movement, source proof, and no unresolved stop rule.Remove from fragile watch and retain as operating standard.Permit broader operating reliance.
